project.title: GUNUNG CIKURAY
project.subtitle: 2.821 MDPL · ATAP LANGIT GARUT
project.angle: Geologi & Sains (Stratovolcano Kuarter, Tanpa Kawah Aktif, Batuan Porus Minim Air, Inversi Suhu Lautan Awan)

verifiedFacts: Elevation: 2.821 mdpl (highest peak in Kabupaten Garut; 4th highest in West Java after Ciremai, Pangrango, Gede).
Topographic prominence: ~2.105 m (ultra-prominent solitary stratovolcano cone south of Cekungan Garut).
Neighboring Priangan volcanoes: Papandayan (2.665 mdpl), Guntur (2.249 mdpl), Galunggung (2.168 mdpl).
Coordinates: -7.3225 lat, 107.8600 lng (bordering Cilawu, Bayongbong, Cikajang, Dayeuhmanggung).
Geology: Quaternary stratovolcano on the Sunda Arc (Indo-Australian Plate subducting beneath Eurasian/Sunda Plate), composed of basaltic-andesite lava flows, pyroclastic deposits, and lahar.
Activity: Dormant stratovolcano with no active fumarolic crater and no confirmed historical eruptions.
Hydrology: Steep porous volcanic strata drain rainfall down toward lower-slope springs, leaving upper hiking trails with minimal natural water sources.
Meteorology: High summit elevation above the bowl-like Cekungan Garut enables morning temperature inversion, trapping cool moist air and dense sea of clouds below the clear summit.

scenes.name: CoolingAndHydrology
